- [USER] User asked about challenges faced by the finance industry in New York City in recent years.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed challenges faced by the finance industry in New York City:

  4. Economic uncertainty affecting the finance industry, including impacts from fiscal policies, interest rates, global trade, and the COVID-19 pandemic.
